name: ShelfAsk – Product Questions & Answers for WooCommerce
author: morpheous7

sections.description:
Shoppers who can’t find an answer leave. ShelfAsk adds a Questions tab to every WooCommerce product page, so they can ask right there, and everyone after them sees your answer.

  • Ask on the product page: A short form in a Questions tab. Guests or logged-in customers, your choice.
  • You stay in control: Questions wait for you under WooCommerce → Questions. Nothing appears on your store until you answer it.
  • Answer once: Your answer shows under the question for every future shopper, so you stop answering the same email again and again.
  • Email when it matters: You get an email for each new question. Shoppers who ask to be told get an email when you answer.
  • Searchable: Once a product has a few answered questions, shoppers can search them.
  • Spam protection built in: A hidden trap field, a signed form, and a limit of 5 questions per visitor per hour. No captcha puzzles for real shoppers.
  • Good for search engines: Answered questions are part of the product page, so search engines can read them.
  • Works with your theme: Uses WooCommerce’s own product tabs, so it works with classic and block themes, and with page caching.

Want to answer once for a whole category, filter spam with Akismet, import questions from another Q&A plugin, and let shoppers vote answers helpful? ShelfAsk Pro is an optional paid add-on. Everything listed above is free and stays free.

ShelfAsk is part of Shelf for WooCommerce: small plugins that answer what shoppers ask before they buy. Its sister plugins are ShelfTabs (reusable Shipping & Returns, Warranty, FAQ and Specifications tabs) and ShelfDate (estimated delivery dates).

Privacy

When a shopper asks a question, ShelfAsk stores the question, the product, and the name and email address they enter. The email is used only to tell them when you answer, if they ask to be told. ShelfAsk sends nothing to outside services.

To limit spam, ShelfAsk keeps a hashed copy of the visitor’s IP address for one hour. The IP address itself is never stored.

ShelfAsk works with WordPress’s own privacy tools:

  • Export Personal Data (Tools → Export Personal Data) includes the questions a person asked with that email address.
  • Erase Personal Data (Tools → Erase Personal Data) removes their name and email from those questions. The question and your answer stay on the product page.
  • Suggested privacy policy text is under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide, ready to copy into your privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Where do I answer questions?

Go to WooCommerce → Questions. Open a question, write your answer in the “Your answer” box, and click Publish. The question and answer then appear on the product page.

Do unanswered questions show on my store?

No. Only questions you have answered and published are shown.

How do I hide a question without deleting it?

Open it and change its status to Draft, then click Update.

Can only logged-in customers ask?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Product questions and set “Who can ask” to “Only logged-in customers”.

Does it work with page caching?

Yes. The form works on cached pages, and new answers appear when your cache refreshes.

Does it affect my product reviews?

No. Questions are stored separately from reviews and do not change your star ratings or review counts.
sections.changelog:
0.1.3

  • Privacy: ShelfAsk now works with WordPress’s Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data tools. Erasing removes the asker’s name and email from their questions and keeps the question and answer text.
  • Privacy: Suggested text for your privacy policy, under Settings > Privacy.
  • A one-time request for a WordPress.org review on the Questions screen, after your first answered question. Dismiss it for 30 days or for good.

0.1.2

  • Translations: Portuguese (Brazil) and Spanish (Spain and Mexico) are now included. WordPress.org language packs are used instead when they exist.

0.1.1

  • Faster: settings are stored together and load with WordPress, and answered questions load in two queries however many there are. Existing settings move over automatically.
  • The settings page shows at most one line about Pro.

0.1.0

  • First release.
